description: Kani 0.67.0 cannot verify digest-based harnesses (PO-xi2f29-009, PO-xi2f29-010, PO-xi2f29-010b) because blake3 uses x86 InlineAsm (__cpuid_count) for CPU feature detection, which is unsupported by Kani's symbolic execution engine. Compensating evidence: proptest 6/6 PASS, unit 5/5 PASS — same code path verified end-to-end through full pipeline.
remediation: Documented in TB-xi2f29-022. No code fix needed — genuine Kani implementation limitation. Proptest + unit tests provide compensating assurance. Future Kani version may lift this restriction.

description: proof-to-implementation-input.md has internal contradiction: line 39 says production code currently returns 'parallel' (stale, pre-fix) while line 43 says 'together' is already returned (correct, post-fix). The production code IS correct (part_05.rs:105 returns 'together'). Documentation needs harmonization.
remediation: Harmonize lines 39 and 43 to reflect actual fixed state. Remove stale pre-fix claim on line 39.

description: canonical_name_all_harness (PO-xi2f29-008) times out (>10 min) due to symbolic state space explosion from discriminant-based enumeration of 12 StepPrimitive variants with Vec/String construction. Individual variant harnesses verified for Together (PO-001: VERIFIED). Contract C-01 only requires Together verification; other variants are out of scope or have existing coverage.
remediation: Split into per-variant harnesses for remaining 11 variants as defense-in-depth optimization in follow-up bead. Together variant already verified by PO-001.

description: Unit test test_canonical_primitive_name_together_returns_together (PO-xi2f29-015, error_variant_tests.rs:1351-1411) does NOT directly assert that canonical_primitive_name(Together) returns 'together'. It only verifies digest non-zero and determinism — properties that would pass regardless of canonical name. The Kani harness (PO-001) directly verifies the assertion with VERIFICATION SUCCESSFUL (0/432 failed). Unit test is redundant but harmless.
remediation: Either add a direct assertion on canonical_primitive_name(Together) output (requires pub(crate) visibility, which already exists) or rename the test to reflect its actual coverage (digest determinism for together workflows).
